pick.headline: CMS Gives States Six More Months to Finish Building Paperwork Machine
pick.take: Verifying everyone's work status turns out to require software, staffing, and guidance, none of which arrived on schedule. Health care's administrative layer usually expands without being asked, so a deadline extension is a rare sign it has limits. Please enjoy the extra half year of not yet being asked for documentation.
